subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SJR23
title: Proposes an amendment to the Oregon Constitution to expand the scope of the term "bills for raising revenue" for a supermajority vote requirement. Refers the proposed amendment to the people for their approval or rejection at the next regular general election.
headline: SJR 23 did not pass

claims.text: SJR 23 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SJR 23 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
SJR 23 is a proposed change to the Oregon Constitution. It would have gone to voters if passed; it did not pass, so it will not be on your ballot.
